column3: MT 64:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. NASB sets the title in braces before verse 1. Close to the Hebrew; “You will preserve” is rendered as an imperative.
Close to the Hebrew; “they bend their arrow, a bitter word” is rendered “They aimed bitter speech as their arrow.”
“They strengthen” is rendered “They hold fast,” and “they speak of hiding snares” as “They talk of laying snares secretly.”
NASB supplies “saying”; “we have finished a plot plotted” is rendered “We are ready with a well-conceived plot.”
The Hebrew past “And God shot” is rendered “But God will shoot.”
“They will shudder” is rendered “will shake the head.”
